module: Flowgraph node "Blacklist Walking" (depends on gameplay_walk). Allows or forbids entering a vehicle from walking mode, via the gameplay_walk blacklist. Input pins: flow, allow (removes from the list), deny (adds), vehId, clear (pulse, empties the list), fill (all vehicles of the project), fillAll (all BeamNGVehicle objects in the scene). Output: flow.
notes: Bug: in fill, the code calls gameplay_walk.addVehicleToBlacklist(sortedIds) with the global variable (nil) instead of id; the list is therefore not filled correctly.
fill and fillAll first empty the blacklist.

work.desc: If flow is active, executes allow/deny (if vehId), clear, fill, fillAll. Copies flow to the output.
